descriptionChirho: The formal act of dedicating or consecrating a sacred structure (altar, temple, wall) to God, referring to the inaugural ceremony that sets apart an object for holy use. Uniformly rendered across languages: Spanish 'dedicacion,' Arabic تدشين (tadshin), Korean 봉헌 (bongheon), Hindi समर्पण (samarpan), Swahili 'wakfu/kuwekwa-wakfu.' The three clusters are purely grammatical variants — construct state 'dedication-of,' absolute 'dedication,' and prepositional 'at the dedication of' — all denoting the same ritual event.
